_meta.title: Finland: offences the police classified as hate crime cases, by municipality, 2006-2025
_meta.measures: Offences known to the authorities, by municipality where the offence was committed and year of reporting. value = hate_case_all_offences: offences in reports the police classified as a "hate crime case" (latest year). Statistics Finland definition: a case is a hate crime case if "the victim, other plaintiff or the police regards the motive for the act to be partly or completely prejudice or hate towards a specific population group" (race, colour, origin, national or ethnic origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, disability or similar; Criminal Code 6:5.4). hate_case_iccs_*: hate crime cases split by ICCS section. all_cases_iccs_*: every recorded offence (any case type) in the ICCS discrimination (0210 and sub-codes) and expression categories (0803.2, incl. 080322 "violations of norms on intolerance and incitement to hatred"); hate_case_iccs_* for the same codes restricted to hate crime cases.
notes: ICCS sub-codes 02101, 02102, 02109, 080321 and 080329 are present in the table but hold no values (".." not applicable) for any municipality or year; they are omitted.
Pertunmaa (municipality 588) is not listed in table 13kq, so it has no data.

These are Statistics Finland counts of the police case-classification flag, not the Police University College annual hate-crime report (which re-reads reports and gives higher totals); the two series differ.
National hate-crime-case totals are 0 in 2006-2010 and 2012 in the source; the flag appears to have been used inconsistently in early years. Values are kept as published.
null = missing in source. Municipalities are on the 1 January 2023 division (309 municipalities). "WHOLE COUNTRY" is kept as a feature without geometry.
_meta.source: Statistics Finland, statistics on offences and coercive measures, StatFin table 13kq "Offences recorded by the International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICCS), year of reporting and the municipality of offence, 2006-2025"
